title: A lease with a TTL frees itself when its owner crashes
caption: SET NX creates the key only if it is absent; PX makes it expire, so a dead holder can't block everyone forever.

messages.label: SET lock:job7 w1 NX PX 30000
messages.note: The key doesn't exist, so it is created: worker 1 holds the lease for 30 s.

messages.label: SET lock:job7 w2 NX PX 30000
messages.note: The key exists, so NX refuses. Worker 2 backs off and retries.

messages.label: crashes mid-job
messages.note: Worker 1 never sends DEL. Without a TTL the job would be stuck forever.

messages.label: SET lock:job7 w2 NX PX 30000
messages.note: The retry now succeeds and worker 2 takes over the job.

scenarios.name: Risk: lease expires mid-work
scenarios.summary: A pause longer than the TTL (GC, swap, slow I/O) lets a second worker take the lease while the first still believes it holds it: two writers.

messages.label: SET lock:job7 w1 NX PX 30000 → OK
40 s GC pause
messages.note: Worker 1 freezes. Its lease expires at 30 s; it can't notice.

messages.label: SET lock:job7 w2 NX PX 30000 → OK
messages.note: Worker 2 legitimately takes the lease and starts the job.

messages.label: write result (stale holder)
messages.note: Worker 1 wakes and writes, unaware. Both workers have now written: the lock didn't protect the data.

scenarios.name: Fix: fencing token
scenarios.summary: Each grant comes with a number that only grows; storage rejects any write carrying a smaller number than it has already seen.
scenarios.caption: The lock alone can't stop a paused holder; the storage that the lock protects has to check the token.

messages.label: lease + INCR fence → 33
messages.note: Taking the lease also returns a fencing token, 33.

messages.label: lease (after expiry) → 34
messages.note: After worker 1's lease lapses, worker 2 gets token 34.

messages.label: write, token 34
messages.note: Storage records 34 as the highest token seen.

messages.label: write, token 33 → rejected
messages.note: The paused worker's late write carries 33 < 34, so storage refuses it.

scenarios.name: Unsafe release
scenarios.summary: A plain DEL by a holder whose lease has already expired deletes someone else's lock. Release only if the value is still yours.

messages.label: SET lock:job7 w1 NX PX 30000
messages.note: Worker 1 holds the lease, then runs slow.

messages.label: SET lock:job7 w2 NX PX 30000 → OK
messages.note: The lease expired, so worker 2 takes it.

messages.label: DEL lock:job7
messages.note: Worker 1 finishes and deletes the key: worker 2's lock is gone, and a third worker can now get in.

messages.label: fix: EVAL if GET == w1 then DEL
messages.note: A tiny Lua script compares and deletes atomically, so only the owner can release.
